                                     ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of thc Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RS3 Residential Single-Unit

(Detached House) District symbols as shown on Map No. 19-1

in the area bounded by:



The alley next north of and parallel to West Touhy Avenue; line 457.87 feet east of and

parallel to North Sacramento Avenue; West Touhy Avenue; and a line 417.87 feet east

of and parallel to North Sacranieuio Avenue.



To those of an RT3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District




SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



Common address of property: 2910 West Touhy Avenue, Chicago
